verdicts.reason: A keeps the 'LOVE. CARE. KIDS.' headline in a yellow box with a thin frame and a reasonably sized photo, so the message and image survive. But the elements are scattered: a stray yellow bar at the top, floating tick marks beside the photo, and a big empty frame with the photo off to the right. The headline box sits outside the photo, so the hierarchy is weak. B is unusable. The photo is a tiny thumbnail in the bottom-left corner and the headline is a small box at the top-left. Four tick marks float alone, there is a large empty outlined rectangle, and a stray bar sits at the top. It loses the hero image and has no composition.
